coordinate_system: glTF meters, +Y up; camera looks local -Z
limitations: GLB stores surfaces, geometry, transforms, cameras and morph clips; Blender area lights and material intensity changes are in runtime-tracks.json and need a renderer integration.
Do not play all clips simultaneously. Stop an object idle when its hover/click begins; blend or restore its rest pose when done.
Blender color management, bloom, shadows and ambient illumination are renderer settings, not portable GLB render results.
Portal approach clips stop at the room monitor; destination worlds are separate assets.
Use ../blog-room-v28.blend for the editable room, piano and original area-light setup; no compact room-export.blend is included in this folder.
Stop Piano_Demo before Piano_Performance, or before playing individual Press clips on the same keys. Piano_Performance also controls WEB_Camera_Main.
